name: Pilate
description: Ruler living at the time of the New Testament

points: “Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea”. Before that, Herod's son Archelaus governed Judea, but only for about three years; he was a bad administrator for Rome, so Rome ruled him out of the way, made Judea a Roman province and put Pontius Pilate there, a Roman, not from Idumea.

There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices. Pilate was a white man; he was killing the Israelites; he murdered many Israelites.

note.label: Know Your Enemy: God's Foes & Ours

points: Some came and told Christ “of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.” Brothers were sacrificing unto God, and Pilate, a Roman, a white man, came and killed them while they were doing it, and mingled their blood with their sacrifices.

“And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.” What is the purpose of men of war? They beat him, and after they beat him they dressed him up and sent him back.

“And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.” They were not close, because Pilate had taken over Jerusalem after Herod's brother lost it. But against the Jews they became confederate, one people. So shall all nations become one people against us; they cannot afford us raising up.
The thorns on Christ’s head were mockery. “Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him”: he got beat, real bad.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: He “besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave.” He had influence because of his wealth, and he used his influence to get the body of Christ and bury him. That is how our brothers and sisters in the entertainment field, in government, wherever, have to roll: secretly, supporting this truth.
But he “besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus”: right then he had to make it known that he was a follower. I want to bury Christ, in my own tomb.

note.label: THE BLACK BOULÉ & BOURGEOISIE IN THE BIBLE

points: Peter names "the God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers," who glorified his Son Jesus, whom they delivered up and denied before Pilate when Pilate was determined to let him go. The oath and promise passed through a royal lineage: Abraham had Ishmael and the sons of Keturah, but Ishmael was rejected and Isaac was chosen.

note.label: Acts 3: The Restitution of All Things

points: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together. So Herod, an Edomite, a white man that was set up by Rome to rule Jerusalem. And Pontius Pilate, another leader set up by Rome. With the Gentiles. And the people of Israel, the religious leaders. They were gathered together against Christ. Antichrist. Why? Because Herod understood, he killed thousands of black babies to prevent Christ from being born. That is antichrist. Because he knew that Christ was supposed to come, and Christ is the king, and he would not be ruling any more. The white man would not be ruling any more. So ever since Christ was born, the antichrist system was set up.

Being let go, they went to their own company and reported all, and they lifted up their voice to God with one accord: Lord, thou art God who made heaven and earth; why did the heathen rage and the people imagine vain things; the kings of the earth stood up and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against his Christ. Against the holy child Jesus, Herod, Pontius Pilate, the Gentiles, and the people of Israel were gathered together, and this same thing is going to happen all over again.

note.label: Acts 4: The Stone the Builders Rejected
